**Is this a new tool or an improvement to an existing one?**
New tool / Improvement to `tools/<slug>/`

**What problem does it solve?**
A clear description of the use case.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to see. For a new tool, note that it must be 100%
client-side with no data collection (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about.

**Additional context**
Anything else worth knowing.
